'''Teronto''' was a [[statuary]] [[Artist/Legends|artist]] known around the [[Old Republic era|time]] of the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. [[Dremullar Obohn di Garthos]], one of the curators of the [[Obohn Gallery of the Industrial Aesthetic]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]], was aware of Teronto's works.<ref name="LP">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/fiction/f20080409/index.html|text="Labor Pains"|int=Labor Pains|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Teronto was mentioned in the [[2008]] short story "[[Labor Pains]]," written by [[John Jackson Miller]] and published on [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]].<ref name="LP" />
